name: Zelicious 1g Pre-Roll
description: Lineage: Zoap x Oishii Type: Hybrid Terps: Limonene, β-Caryophyllene, Linalool Effects: Relaxed, Euphoric, Creative Aroma: Citrus Zelicious is a tropical escape in every puff.
